children.description: The button label. The trailing chevron is only rendered when a label is present.

disabled.description: Disables the button when set to true.

startIcon.description: An optional icon placed before the label. Pass the SDS Icon component, for example <Icon sdsIcon="Download" sdsSize="s" />.

size.description: Size of the button. Also sets the size of the trailing chevron.

sdsStyle.description: Style of the button. Same values as Button.

sdsType.description: Color scheme of the button. Unlike Button, "destructive" is not supported.

onClick.description: Callback fired when the button is clicked. Typically used to open the associated menu.
